parsed.production_notes: The video is a mix of AI-generated and human-recorded footage. The tutor character is a stylized AI avatar with glowing facial markings, while the learner is a live-action recording of a real person.
parsed.interaction_pattern: AI tutor SAYS a phrase in Marathi, human learner TRANSLATES it into English (translation drill).
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue between two characters, followed by a voiceover from one character. There is no background music.

characters.appearance: A young woman in her early 20s with East Asian features, a slim build, and fair complexion. She has shoulder-length brown hair and perfectly symmetrical features. Distinctive glowing blue lines run down her cheeks from her eyes to her jawline, giving her a futuristic look.
characters.wardrobe: A shiny, metallic, bronze-colored hooded sweatshirt.
characters.demeanor: Friendly, encouraging, and calm, with a consistent gentle smile and an open, inviting hand gesture.

characters.appearance: A young South Asian woman in her early 20s with a medium build and a light brown complexion. She has dark brown hair tied back from her face, dark eyes, and a small silver nose ring in her left nostril.
characters.wardrobe: A simple, light blue crew-neck t-shirt and black in-ear headphones.
characters.demeanor: Attentive, cheerful, and engaged. She looks directly forward and smiles confidently as she speaks.

scenes.setting: A composite screen. The AI tutor is in a dark, futuristic room with neon purple and blue lights. The human learner is in a brightly lit room with a plain white wall.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up, talking-head style for both characters.

panels.panel_visual_description: A composite video frame with a vertical orientation. The top third of the frame is a solid light beige color. The bottom two-thirds of the frame is split vertically into two panels. The left panel shows a medium close-up of an AI-generated young woman (Character A) with glowing blue lines on her face, sitting in a dark room illuminated by purple and blue neon lights. The right panel shows a medium close-up of a real young South Asian woman (Character B) with a nose ring, sitting in a brightly lit room against a plain white wall. Both characters are looking forward and speaking.

scenes.visual_description: A vertical video with a beige banner at the top displaying text in Marathi and English. Below the banner, the screen is split vertically. On the left is the AI tutor (Character A) and on the right is the human learner (Character B). They engage in a call-and-response language drill, and the text in the top banner updates with each phrase they say.

Character A says: तू Red म्हण, मी Black म्हणते. चला, सुरु करूया. [You say Red, I'll say Black. Let's start.]
Character B says: Yes, सुरु करूया. [Yes, let's start.]
Character A says: मी आता नाश्ता करत आहे. [I am having breakfast now.]
Character B says: I am having breakfast right now.
Character A says: तू कुठे जात आहेस? [Where are you going?]
Character B says: Where are you going?
Character A says: मला थोडं पाणी दे ना. [Please give me some water.]
Character B says: Please give me some water.
Character A says: आज खूप गरम आहे. [It is very hot today.]
Character B says: It is very hot today.
Character A says: मी तुला नंतर फोन करतो. [I will call you later.]
Character B says: I will call you later.
Character A says: मला हे समजलं नाही. [I did not understand this.]
Character B says: I did not understand this.
Character A says: तू माझी मदत करू शकतेस का? [Can you help me?]
Character B says: Can you help me?
Character A says: छान! आता शेवटचं वाक्य, मला इंग्लिश बोलायला शिकायचं आहे. [Great! Now the last sentence, I want to learn to speak English.]
Character B says: I want to learn how to speak English.
